The Christians, on their part, did their utmost to outdo the idolaters on the same ground where, not long since, they had held quite the second place.

arxiv-1905-10190.title: Low-pass-filter-based shock response spectrum and the evaluation method of transmissibility between equipment and sensitive components interfaces Journal: Mechanical Systems and Signal Processing
arxiv-1905-10190.creator: Yinzhong Yan, Q.M. Li
arxiv-1905-10190.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Yinzhong Yan, Q.M. Li. According to the features of the sources of pyroshock and ballistic shock, this study considers the pyroshock and ballistic shock generated by their respective impulsive sources as damped harmonic waves with different frequencies. According to the linear superposition assumption of damped harmonic waves in a linear elastic structure, a shock analysis method based on low-pass-filtered shock signals and their corresponding shock response spectrum (SRS), termed as low-pass-filter-based shock response spectrum (LPSRS), is proposed.

arxiv-2012-02584.title: Essentially commuting dual truncated Toeplitz operators
arxiv-2012-02584.creator: Chongchao Wang 1, Xianfeng Zhao 2, Dechao Zheng 3
arxiv-2012-02584.description: Abstract . In this paper, we completely characterize when two dual truncated Toeplitz operators are essentially commuting and when the semicommutator of two dual truncated Toeplitz operators is compact. Our main idea is to study dual truncated Toeplitz operators via Hankel operators, Toeplitz operators and function algebras. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 47B32, 47B35 1.

arxiv-2104-07183.title: Evaluating Standard Feature Sets Towards Increased Generalisability and Explainability of ML-based Network Intrusion Detection
arxiv-2104-07183.creator: Mohanad Sarhan, Siamak Layeghy, Marius Portmann
arxiv-2104-07183.description: Abstract Machine Learning (ML)-based network intrusion detection systems bring many benefits for enhancing the cybersecurity posture of an organisation. Many systems have been designed and developed in the research community, often achieving a close to perfect detection rate when evaluated using synthetic datasets. However, the high number of academic research has not often translated into practical deployments.

arxiv-2107-03643.title: A Pila–Wilkie theorem for Hensel minimal curves Thanks: The author V.C-F. was partially supported by KU Leuven IF C14/17/083. The author K.H.N. was partially supported by Research Foundation - Flanders (FWO) 12X3519N and by Vietnam National Foundation for Science and Technology Development (NAFOSTED
arxiv-2107-03643.creator: Victoria Cantoral Farfán, Kien Huu Nguyen, Mathias Stout, Floris Vermeulen
arxiv-2107-03643.description: Abstract . Recently, a new axiomatic framework for tameness in henselian valued fields was developed by Cluckers, Halupczok, Rideau-Kikuchi and Vermeulen and termed Hensel minimality. In this article we develop Diophantine applications of Hensel minimality. We prove a Pila–Wilkie type theorem for transcendental curves definable in Hensel minimal structures.

arxiv-2112-13921.title: Apparent horizons of the Thakurta spacetime and the description of cosmological black holes
arxiv-2112-13921.creator: Archil Kobakhidze, Zachary S. C. Picker
arxiv-2112-13921.description: Abstract We discuss the validity of the Thakurta metric to describe cosmological black holes by analysing the nature of its horizon. By adopting the preferred foliation of the Thakurta spacetime associated with the Kodama time, we demonstrate that the Thakurta horizon is indeed a future outer trapping horizon.

arxiv-2211-06134.title: Active Task Randomization: Learning Robust Skills via Unsupervised Generation of Diverse and Feasible Tasks
arxiv-2211-06134.creator: Kuan Fang, Toki Migimatsu, Ajay Mandlekar, Li Fei-Fei, Jeannette Bohg
arxiv-2211-06134.description: Abstract Solving real-world manipulation tasks requires robots to have a repertoire of skills applicable to a wide range of circumstances. When using learning-based methods to acquire such skills, the key challenge is to obtain training data that covers diverse and feasible variations of the task, which often requires non-trivial manual labor and domain knowledge.

arxiv-2212-04979.title: VideoCoCa: Video-Text Modeling with Zero-Shot Transfer from Contrastive Captioners
arxiv-2212-04979.creator: Shen Yan Tao Zhu Zirui Wang Yuan Cao Mi Zhang, Soham Ghosh Yonghui Wu Jiahui Yu
arxiv-2212-04979.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Shen Yan Tao Zhu Zirui Wang Yuan Cao Mi Zhang, Soham Ghosh Yonghui Wu Jiahui Yu. We explore an efficient approach to establish a foundational video-text model. We present VideoCoCa that maximally reuses a pretrained image-text contrastive captioner (CoCa) model and adapt it to video-text tasks with minimal extra training.

arxiv-2303-04095.title: Investigating and modeling day-to-day route choices based on laboratory experiments. Part II: A route-dependent attraction-based stochastic process model
arxiv-2303-04095.creator: Hang Qi, Ning Jia, Xiaobo Qu, Zhengbing He
arxiv-2303-04095.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Hang Qi, Ning Jia, Xiaobo Qu, Zhengbing He. To explain day-to-day (DTD) route-choice behaviors and traffic dynamics observed in a series of lab experiments, Part I of this research proposed a discrete choice-based analytical dynamic model ( Qi et al. Although the deterministic model could well reproduce the experimental observations, it converges to a stable equilibrium of route flow while the observed DTD evolution is apparently with random oscillations.

arxiv-2303-07560.title: Machine Learning Computer Vision Applications for Spatial AI Object Recognition in Orange County, California
arxiv-2303-07560.creator: Dr. Kostas Alexandridis, GISP
arxiv-2303-07560.description: Abstract We provide an integrated and systematic automation approach to spatial object recognition and positional detection using AI machine learning and computer vision algorithms for Orange County, California. We describe a comprehensive methodology for multi-sensor, high-resolution field data acquisition, along with post-field processing and pre-analysis processing tasks.

arxiv-2406-07548.title: Image and Video Tokenization with Binary Spherical Quantization
arxiv-2406-07548.creator: Yue Zhao, Yuanjun Xiong, Philipp Krähenbühl
arxiv-2406-07548.description: Abstract We propose a new transformer-based image and video tokenizer with Binary Spherical Quantization (BSQ). BSQ projects the high-dimensional visual embedding to a lower-dimensional hypersphere and then applies binary quantization. BSQ is (1) parameter-efficient without an explicit codebook, (2) scalable to arbitrary token dimensions, and (3) compact: compressing visual data by up to 100 × \times with minimal distortion.

arxiv-2407-09147.title: AI-Powered Immersive Assistance for Interactive Task Execution in Industrial Environments
arxiv-2407-09147.creator: Tomislav Duricic, Peter Müllner, Nicole Weidinger, Neven ElSayed, Dominik Kowald, Eduardo Veas
arxiv-2407-09147.description: Abstract Many industrial sectors rely on well-trained employees that are able to operate complex machinery. In this work, we demonstrate an AI-powered immersive assistance system that supports users in performing complex tasks in industrial environments. Specifically, our system leverages a VR environment that resembles a juice mixer setup.

arxiv-2407-11788.title: Learning Feasible Transitions for Efficient Contact Planning
arxiv-2407-11788.creator: Rikhat Akizhanov, Victor Dhédin, Majid Khadiv, Ivan Laptev
arxiv-2407-11788.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose an efficient contact planner for quadrupedal robots to navigate in extremely constrained environments such as stepping stones. The main difficulty in this setting stems from the mixed nature of the problem, namely discrete search over the steppable patches and continuous trajectory optimization.

arxiv-2409-09255.title: Kac diagrams for elliptic Weyl group elements
arxiv-2409-09255.creator: Stephen DeBacker, Jacob Haley
arxiv-2409-09255.description: Abstract . Suppose 𝔤 {\mathfrak{g}} is a semisimple complex Lie algebra and 𝔥 {\mathfrak{h}} is a Cartan subalgebra of 𝔤 {\mathfrak{g}} . To the pair ( 𝔤 , 𝔥 ) ({\mathfrak{g}},{\mathfrak{h}}) one can associate both a Weyl group and a set of Kac diagrams.

arxiv-2411-04435.title: Extending the Dark Matter Reach of Water Cherenkov Detectors using Jupiter
arxiv-2411-04435.creator: Sandra Robles, Stephan A. Meighen-Berger
arxiv-2411-04435.description: Abstract We propose the first method for water Cherenkov detectors to constrain GeV-scale dark matter (DM) below the solar evaporation mass. While previous efforts have highlighted the Sun and Earth as DM capture targets, we demonstrate that Jupiter is a viable target.

arxiv-2412-04780.title: Anomaly Detection and Classification in Knowledge Graphs Journal: Information Sciences
arxiv-2412-04780.creator: Asara Senaratne, Peter Christen, Pouya Omran, Graham Williams {asara.senaratne, peter.christen, p.g.omran, graham.williams}@anu.edu.au School of Computing Australian National University
arxiv-2412-04780.description: Abstract Anomalies such as redundant, inconsistent, contradictory, and deficient values in a Knowledge Graph (KG) are unavoidable, as these graphs are often curated manually, or extracted using machine learning and natural language processing techniques. Therefore, anomaly detection is a task that can enhance the quality of KGs.

arxiv-2511-14710.title: Towards a Unified Analysis of Neural Networks in Nonparametric Instrumental Variable Regression: Optimization and Generalization
arxiv-2511-14710.creator: Zonghao Chen, Atsushi Nitanda, Arthur Gretton, Taiji Suzuki
arxiv-2511-14710.description: Abstract We establish the first global convergence result of neural networks for two stage least squares (2SLS) approach in nonparametric instrumental variable regression (NPIV). This is achieved by adopting a lifted perspective through mean-field Langevin dynamics (MFLD), unlike standard MFLD, however, our setting of 2SLS entails a bilevel optimization problem in the space of probability measures.

pmc-11417704.title: Improving the Monitoring and Management of Clozapine-Induced Gastrointestinal Hypomotility (CIGH) in Community Mental Health Services: A Quality Improvement Approach
pmc-11417704.creator: Balazs Adam, Osama Ayad
pmc-11417704.description: Clozapine is the only approved antipsychotic for refractory schizophrenia to date. It can cause a range of serious and fatal adverse effects, including Clozapine-Induced Gastrointestinal Hypomotility (CIGH). While guidance is readily available to help manage CIGH effectively in hospital inpatients, practical recommendations applicable to the community (outpatient) setting are lacking.

pmc-12470519.title: 4-Propylphenol Alters Membrane Integrity in Fungi Isolated from Walnut Anthracnose and Brown Spot
pmc-12470519.creator: Xiaoli Yu, Shuhan Yang, Panhong Su, Haiyao Bi, Yaxuan Li, Xingxing Peng, Xiaohui Sun, Qunqing Wang
pmc-12470519.description: Walnut anthracnose (Colletotrichum gloeosporioides and C. siamense) and brown spot (Alternaria alternata) cause severe yield losses globally. Conventional fungicides face the challenges of pathogen resistance and environmental toxicity. This study evaluates 4-propylphenol, a plant-derived phenolic compound, as an eco-friendly alternative against key fungal pathogens of walnut. In vitro assays determined EC50 values against target pathogens (29.11–31.

pmc-12631244.title: Combination of FTO and BTK inhibitors synergistically suppresses the malignancy of breast cancer cells
pmc-12631244.creator: Abdulaziz Ahmed A Saad, Lichen Ge, Haoran Wang, Yan Xia, Jianing Li, Shiyao Qiao, Cheng Yi, Xiansong Wang, Zhaotong Wang, Dan Zhou, Hongsheng Wang
pmc-12631244.description: Despite significant progress in breast cancer treatment, more effective methods for its clinical management are still needed. Our data identified that fat mass and obesity-associated protein (FTO), an N6-methyladenosine (m6A) demethylase, is highly expressed in breast cancer and promotes tumorigenesis. Inhibiting FTO can suppress the proliferation and metastasis of breast cancer, while its efficacy needs to be further improved.

pmc-12724339.title: Sargassum fusiforme polysaccharides modulate gut microbiota and metabolites to regulate hyperlipidemia in mice fed a high-fat diet
pmc-12724339.creator: Ning Su, Shiwei Han, Zhengyang Li, Xiaoyu Ling, Lingqing Kong, Dafeng Song
pmc-12724339.description: Hyperlipidemia complications caused by obesity are a hot issue threatening human health worldwide, and there is an urgent need to explore low-toxicity health foods for intervention. Sargassum fusiforme polysaccharides (SFPS) display cholesterol-lowering properties, but the underlying mechanism has not been elucidated.

pmc-13212387.title: What do health insurance deductibles do to health care spending growth?
pmc-13212387.creator: Claudio Lucarelli, Molly Frean, Aliza S. Gordon, Lynn M. Hua, Mark V. Pauly
pmc-13212387.description: Costly new technology, while often beneficial, has been identified as one of the principal drivers of healthcare spending growth. Recent literature has shown high deductible health plans (HDHPs) can have an immediate negative impact on levels of healthcare spending, but their effects on spending growth remain unknown.

pmc-13348996.title: Acute Decompensation Requiring Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation in a 15-Year-Old With Undiagnosed Lyme Carditis
pmc-13348996.creator: Anne-Sophie Gervais, Joshua Feder, Earl Rubin, Virginie Beauséjour-Ladouceur, Marina Salvadori
pmc-13348996.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). We describe the case of a previously healthy teenager who developed third-degree atrioventricular block due to Lyme disease. While Lyme carditis is common in children, severe conduction anomalies remain rare but can be life-threatening. This case highlights the importance of early recognition, prompt testing, and timely intervention to prevent unnecessary procedures, such as permanent pacemaker implantation, and to ensure favorable outcomes.

pmc-13683389.title: Structural and immunogenic characterisation of ChAdOx1 Chik-derived Chikungunya VLPs supports a mechanistic rationale for vaccine-induced protection
pmc-13683389.creator: Young Chan Kim, Xiyong Song, Yasunori Watanabe, Raquel de Oliveira Souza, Robert Stass, Sthefany Pagliari, Max Crispin, Beate Mareike Kümmerer, Carla Claser, Thomas A Bowden, Juha T Huiskonen, Arturo Reyes-Sandoval
pmc-13683389.description: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is a mosquito-borne alphavirus that causes severe chronic arthritis in humans and constitutes an expanding global threat. We previously reported that a single unadjuvanted dose of ChAdOx1 Chik vaccine was safe and elicited cross-protective functional antibodies against four distinctive CHIKV lineages in a Phase 1 trial.
